cards.explanation: The answer is that the LORD does not change. He says, “Because I, the LORD, do not change, you descendants of Jacob have not been destroyed.” (Malachi 3:6) Jacob's descendants were not the steady ones here. God was. Think of the one oven in my bakery that never swings in temperature, friends. That's the one you trust with the batch.

The LORD tells them to return to Him. After all those years, He doesn't say, "Pack it up." He says, “Return to Me, and I will return to you…” (Malachi 3:7) The door is open, friends. I spent years forgotten in the back of a junk drawer before an angel called me out, so that line hits me right in the apron.

The answer is True. The LORD of Hosts says, “Return to Me, and I will return to you…” (Malachi 3:7) Hear that, friends? It's an invitation with a promise riding on it. When they come back, He comes back to them.

The answer is "How can we return?" The text says, “But you ask, ‘How can we return?’” (Malachi 3:7) They ask how the return is done. I think that's a fair question, honestly. I've asked "how" at the oven door more times than I can count.

The answer is tithes and offerings. They ask, “How do we rob You?” and the answer is short: “In tithes and offerings.” (Malachi 3:8) No long speech and no hint of a riddle, friends. The LORD tells them plainly where the problem is.

The answer is False. The LORD doesn't say only a few. He says, “You are cursed with a curse, yet you—the whole nation—are still robbing Me.” (Malachi 3:9) He speaks of the whole nation, friends, so it's much bigger than a handful of people.

The answer is food. He says, “Bring the full tithe into the storehouse, so that there may be food in My house.” (Malachi 3:10) The tithe goes in so there's food in His house. As a guy who lives by the oven, friends, I like where this is going.

The word is blessing. The LORD of Hosts says, “See if I will not open the windows of heaven and pour out for you blessing without measure.” (Malachi 3:10) Without measure means no cup, no scoop and no limit. I've never had that much sprinkles in my life, friends, and I'd still take it.

The answer is the fruits of their land. The LORD says, “I will rebuke the devourer for you, so that it will not destroy the fruits of your land…” (Malachi 3:11) He's the One standing between that devourer and their harvest, friends. That's a promise worth a good cookie box.

The answer is False. The LORD says, “…the vine in your field will not fail to produce fruit…” (Malachi 3:11) The vine is going to produce, friends. That's a promise that doesn't come with an "if the weather feels like it."
The word is blessed. The LORD of Hosts says, “Then all the nations will call you blessed…” (Malachi 3:12) The whole world takes notice, friends. They'd look at Israel and say that word.
